research.searchCoverage: Official Beaconcha.in V2 API (POST /api/v2/ethereum/queues, /performance-aggregate, /validators) with Authorization Bearer, bitfly GmbH Vienna identity, API key portal, and dated incident search (beaconcha.in / bitfly / Beaconcha.in security breach/incident, excluding Beacon CRM and unrelated crypto exploits) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying current unresolved Beaconcha.in API/customer-data compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official V2 API is HTTPS POST https://beaconcha.in/api/v2/ethereum/* with Authorization Bearer. Network queues and network performance-aggregate are available on all plans. Operator is bitfly GmbH, Vienna. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved Beaconcha.in compromise.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
